question: What understanding has been gained through the grace of the lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge has arisen by that lord's grace.
What is known is the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: Therefore by the lord's grace the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
